tool.title: May this step be performed?
tool.description: Ask before doing work a strict process governs. The content-agnostic processes refuse a step that is not enabled; the per-content-type ones advise.

inputs.name: actor
inputs.description: Who you say would perform it. Recorded only: strict mode authorizes the principal GitHub vouches for (issue #1207).

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: The content it would act on, for the access check.

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.description: Permitted, refused with the reason, or advisory — and the task-authorization verdict.
